# VNDK 31 stays private to target-firmware HALs.
# Stable C LLNDK interfaces are resolved in the modern system namespace.
dir.vendor = /twrp_vendor/bin

[vendor]
additional.namespaces = system
namespace.default.isolated = true
namespace.default.search.paths = /twrp_vendor/${LIB}:/twrp_vendor/${LIB}/hw
namespace.default.permitted.paths = /twrp_vendor/${LIB}
namespace.default.links = system
namespace.default.link.system.shared_libs = libc.so:libm.so:libdl.so:liblog.so:libbinder_ndk.so
namespace.system.isolated = true
namespace.system.search.paths = /system/${LIB}
namespace.system.permitted.paths = /system/${LIB}
